verdict.rationale: Parsec documents keyboard and mouse support and remote control of the host, and Wacom pressure and tilt passthrough suggests fine-grained input forwarding. However, the evidence never mentions scroll input or confirms that input arrives on the host as native events, and only marketing one-liners support the claim. Missing for 10: scroll input passthrough, explicit native-event injection on the host, any in-depth documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of input fidelity.

support.subject: As a power user, mouse, keyboard, and scroll input from the viewing device lands on the host as native events

citations.quote: share a link, and a team member can observe or even take control of your computer.
